title: Prognostic and Therapeutic Significance of DPP4 in SMARCA4-Deficient Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer.
authors: Chen, Chaopeng; Zhong, Zebin; Luo, Xiaoling; Dai, Weiping; Xu, Lujian; Cai, Wenping; Xu, Zhibin; Liang, Guolian; Pang, Lijuan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究SMARCA4缺陷非小细胞肺癌中DPP4的表达与预后及治疗意义，属于纯临床肿瘤学与湿实验研究，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: IntroductionSMARCA4-deficient NSCLC is an aggressive subtype lacking robust biomarkers and therapeutic targets. To define the expression pattern and clinical significance of DPP4 in SMARCA4-dNSCLC and explore whether DPP4 may represent a therapeutic vulnerability in this subtype.Materials and MethodsThe Cancer Genome Atlas NSCLC cohort was analyzed to compare SMARCA4-low tumors with adjacent normal lung using differential expression, Cox regression, protein-protein interaction networks, and machine-learning ranking. An exploratory immunohistochemistry case series of SMARCA4-dNSCLC from three centers (n=9) quantified DPP4 by percentage of tumor cells; >/=20% cells defined DPP4-high. Clinicopathologic features, RECIST response, and survival were summarized descriptively by DPP4 status. In HCC827 cells, SMARCA4 knockdown and DPP4 inhibition (P32/98) were evaluated alone and in combination using colony-formation, and motility (migration/wound-healing) assays.ResultsDPP4 was downregulated in SMARCA4-low tumors versus adjacent normal lung, yet within tumors higher residual DPP4 expression was associated with worse overall and disease-free survival. In the immunohistochemistry case series, DPP4 protein expression was weaker in SMARCA4-dNSCLC than in adjacent alveolar epithelium. Within this low-expressing background, DPP4-high tumors showed descriptive trends toward inferior survival, lower disease-control rate after first-line therapy, and more extensive baseline organ involvement than DPP4-low tumors. In vitro, SMARCA4 knockdown and P32/98 each reduced clonogenic growth and motility versus control, with the combination producing the greatest inhibition (about 60%-70% reductions).ConclusionsDPP4 is downregulated at the mRNA and protein levels in SMARCA4-dNSCLC compared with normal lung, yet higher residual expression may mark a more aggressive phenotype. Combined SMARCA4 knockdown and DPP4 inhibition suppress growth and motility in vitro, suggesting DPP4 as a candidate prognostic marker and a candidate therapeutic target that requires orthogonal specificity controls and validation in larger cohorts.
abstract_zh: 引言SMARCA4缺陷型非小细胞肺癌（SMARCA4-dNSCLC）是一种侵袭性亚型，缺乏稳健的生物标志物和治疗靶点。本研究旨在明确DPP4在SMARCA4-dNSCLC中的表达模式及临床意义，并探讨DPP4是否可能成为该亚型的治疗脆弱点。材料与方法分析癌症基因组图谱（The Cancer Genome Atlas）NSCLC队列，通过差异表达分析、Cox回归、蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络及机器学习排序，比较SMARCA4低表达肿瘤与邻近正常肺组织。一项来自三个中心的探索性免疫组织化学病例系列（n=9）对SMARCA4-dNSCLC中DPP4进行定量，以肿瘤细胞百分比表示；≥20%细胞定义为DPP4高表达。按DPP4状态描述性总结临床病理特征、RECIST反应及生存情况。在HCC827细胞中，分别及联合评估SMARCA4敲低和DPP4抑制（P32/98）对集落形成和运动性（迁移/伤口愈合）的影响。结果与邻近正常肺组织相比，SMARCA4低表达肿瘤中DPP4表达下调，但在肿瘤内部，较高的残留DPP4表达与较差的总生存期和无病生存期相关。在免疫组织化学病例系列中，SMARCA4-dNSCLC中DPP4蛋白表达弱于邻近肺泡上皮。在此低表达背景下，DPP4高表达肿瘤显示出较DPP4低表达肿瘤更差的生存趋势、一线治疗后更低的疾病控制率及更广泛的基线器官受累。体外实验中，与对照组相比，SMARCA4敲低和P32/98各自均减少克隆形成生长和运动性，联合使用产生最大抑制效果（约减少60%-70%）。结论与正常肺组织相比，SMARCA4-dNSCLC中DPP4在mRNA和蛋白水平均下调，但较高的残留表达可能标志更具侵袭性的表型。SMARCA4敲低与DPP4抑制联合在体外抑制生长和运动性，提示DPP4可作为候选预后标志物及候选治疗靶点，但需正交特异性对照及更大队列验证。
